definitions.explanation: An organized body of soldiers, ranging from a small squad to a large force. By extension, any organized team dispatched for a task.

examples.japanese: {部隊|ぶたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出動|しゅつどう}→出動：28803_shutsudou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{特殊|とくしゅ}→特殊：04566_tokushu⟧{部隊|ぶたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: A special unit headed to the scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧{部隊|ぶたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{昼夜|ちゅうや}→昼夜：12993_chuuya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A rescue unit was dispatched to the disaster area and worked around the clock.

notes:
{部隊|ぶたい} refers to an organized military unit, but is also used figuratively for any task team or squad.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{特殊|とくしゅ}→特殊：04566_tokushu⟧{部隊|ぶたい}: special forces unit
- {部隊|ぶたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispatch a unit
- {機動|きどう}{部隊|ぶたい}: mobile unit; task force

USAGE:
Not to be confused with its homophone ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧ (stage), written with different kanji.
